scope: Straightforward dense double C rolling fit, QR token and Gaussian history; no model or estimator tuning
tests: independent NumPy Gaussian conditioning and full covariance
token quadratic likelihood and float32 codec
chronology, interval, atomic failure and pending retry
saved four-hour CCCV and weak-excitation replay
host profiling and Cortex-M23 cross-build/stack accounting

criteria.long_run_comparison: Report all discrepancies, never abort other arms; application scales 0.5 percent Q and 0.5 SOC points are assessment scales, not proof of numerical equality

limits: stationary reference parameters; aging not added
host timing is not target timing
synchronous in-process retirement; distributed/persistent transaction protocol outside baseline scope
